title: ArborEnum: Decision Tree Rashomon Sets over Continuous Features
abstract: arXiv:2608.04310v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Rashomon effect describes the phenomenon that many models can achieve nearly equivalent performance on the same learning task, with significant ramifications for robustness, feature importance, and customizability. These use cases motivate the computation of Rashomon sets: the set of all models whose regularized loss is near-optimal. Decision trees are one of the few model classes for which Rashomon sets can be fully enumerated, but this computation has always been conditional on a binarization of the original data, either restricting which splits each tree is allowed to make or substantially increasing the complexity of an already difficult combinatorial problem. We introduce the first algorithm that exactly enumerates decision-tree Rashomon sets while exploiting the ordered structure of continuous features. translated_title: ArborEnum：基于连续特征的决策树Rashomon集合枚举
translated_abstract: Rashomon效应描述了许多模型在同一学习任务上能够取得几乎同等性能的现象，这对模型的鲁棒性、特征重要性和可定制性具有重要意义。这些应用场景促使人们计算Rashomon集合：即所有正则化损失接近最优的模型的集合。决策树是为数不多的可以完全枚举Rashomon集合的模型类别之一，但此类计算一直依赖于对原始数据的二值化处理，要么限制每棵树允许进行的分裂方式，要么大幅增加原本已经十分困难的组合问题的复杂性。我们提出了首个能够在利用连续特征有序结构的同时精确枚举决策树Rashomon集合的算法。我们还进一步开发了用于近似枚举的松弛方法以及一种随时算法，该算法可以逐步细化模型集合……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个利用连续特征有序结构来精确枚举决策树Rashomon集合的算法，并进一步提供了用于近似枚举的松弛方法和可逐步细化结果的随时算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first algorithm that exactly enumerates decision-tree Rashomon sets by exploiting the ordered structure of continuous features, along with a relaxation for approximate enumeration and an anytime algorithm that progressively refines the set.
